copy.reason: Match the fix applied to the project page title (missing space before the hyphen).

questions: Cover title "Torrey Ridge- Courtyard Intervention" has no space before the hyphen ("Ridge-" not "Ridge -"). It matches the project's own page title exactly, so I left it, but it reads like a missing space.

The MindAlign 2023 cover image's artwork itself reads "Align Your Mind with... Tumeric" (should probably be "Turmeric"). That text is baked into the image, not editable text, so I described it as shown rather than correcting it — flagging in case the source graphic should be fixed.
